info.name: Ankorstore Stock Tracking and Logistics Applications State API
Stock quantities by location and status

params.name: filter[productVariantIds][]
params.description: A set of identifiers representing the items to check quantities for

params.name: filter[status][]
params.description: A set of statuses to check quantities for

params.name: filter[locationTypes][]
params.description: A set of location types to check quantities at

params.name: filter[locationIds][]
params.description: A set of identifiers representing the locations to check quantities at

params.name: filter[productType]
params.description: A specific product type to check quantities for

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: limit the amount of results returned

params.name: page[before]
params.description: show items before the provided ID (uuid format)

params.name: page[after]
params.description: show items after the provided ID (uuid format)

params.name: stateAt
params.description: obtain state up to and including transactions for the given timestamp

items.docs:
Return the current quantity for a given product variant across locations, statuses and potentially lots.
One stock state entity is returned per product variant, so the identifier of each entity will correspond with
the product variant identifier for which quantities are returned.

Override the stock state for one or more product variants.
* Only brand locations and available or onHand statuses are available for update.
* You may only specify either onHand or available for the same product variant and location, not both.
* Please include only absolute quantities.
